resources.name: Thermochemical data for oxides and elements

access.notes: CSV file provided with the task; contains ΔH_f⁰(298), S⁰(298), and Cp(T) coefficients for RuO₂, In₂O₃, ZnO, Rh₂O₃, IrO₂, ReO₂, and the elemental metals.
CSV file provided with the task; contains nominal composition, lattice parameters a, c, V, and experimental matrix compositions from WDXS for all samples plus homogeneity‑range reference data.
